overview: We connect your Wix app to the services your users already rely on, such as Stripe, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Wix Stores, Wix Bookings or your own API. Each link uses secure key storage or OAuth, retries when a service is down and shows clear messages in the dashboard if something fails. We test with sandbox accounts and write a short guide to every connection.

faq: Stripe, PayPal, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Slack, accounting tools and any service with a public API are common. Send the API documentation of yours and we confirm the fit first.
Do the connected tools cost extra?
Possibly. Each tool bills you or your users directly. Our price covers building and testing the connection only, and we flag any paid API tiers before we start.
Can I connect my own server?
Yes. We build against your API, or write a small service if you do not have one. We agree the fields and the direction of the sync in writing before we start building.
Where are the API keys stored?
In the Wix Secrets Manager or your own server settings, never in code that runs in the browser. We never ask for passwords, and use test keys or collaborator access instead.
